name: OpenRouter
measures: Tokens used per AI model, by month
about: OpenRouter lets developers reach many AI models through one service, and publishes tokens per model through its Data API. We show monthly totals and the most used models.
attribution: Source: OpenRouter (openrouter.ai/rankings), as of 2026-11-01T09:28:31.358Z. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
limitations: It only covers public traffic through OpenRouter, not all AI usage.
Tokens are counted by each provider's tokenizer, so they are not directly comparable across providers.
Published figures can be restated as OpenRouter refreshes its data.
